findings.finding: Restricting the local Scheffer/CKN energy inequality to a backward parabolic neighborhood of only the KNSS record-center trajectory does not derive the local L3 bound: the local pressure decomposition is circular at short range (near-field Calderon-Zygmund term equals the sought cubic quantity) and supercritical at long range (far-field tail controlled only at rate E0*M_k/L, same as the velocity term), and fixed-radius time averaging only selects k-dependent good times that cannot be transferred to the fixed profile times KNSS compactness requires.
